name: Staff of Bolstering
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 195, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 296
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 195, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 296
Aura moderate transmutation CL 8th
Slot none; Price 41,600 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
The top of this rosewood shaft narrows and then expands again, bound by a number of metal rings. It allows use of the following spells:
Bear’s endurance (1 charge)
Bull’s strength (1 charge)
Cat’s grace (1 charge)
Greater magic weapon (1 charge)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, bear’s endurance, bull’s strength, cat’s grace, greater magic weapon; Cost 20,800 gp
